examples.text: За весь день ей приходи́лось жева́ть то́лько два ра́за: поку́шала у переплё́тчика немно́жко кле́йстеру да в одно́м из тракти́ров о́коло прила́вка нашла́ колба́сную ко́жицу — вот и всё.
examples.translation: Only twice in the whole day had she had anything to eat: at the bookbinder’s she had lapped up some paste, and in one of the taverns she had found a sausage skin near the counter—that was all.

glosses: A food made of ground meat (or meat substitute) and seasoning, packed in a section of the animal's intestine, or in a similarly cylindrical shaped synthetic casing; a length of this food.

examples.text: my little sausage

examples.text: I got fired and I'm back on the sausage again.

glosses: To squeeze tightly into (something) in a rolled or sausage-like form.

examples.text: He leapt to his feet, carefully sausaged his screwdrivers in a roll beneath his arm and turned to reach into the box.
